headline: Strong Q1 recovery with sales up 64% YoY to $7.25M (second-best quarter in company history), EBITDA positive at +$0.55M vs a loss in prior period; order book above $10M and December quarter momentum expected
reasoning: FOS Capital delivered a materially stronger-than-expected first quarter for FY27 following a difficult FY26 impacted by project delays. Sales of $7.25M were up 64% on the prior year and represent the second-best quarter in company history, while EBITDA of +$0.55M reversed a prior-year loss. The recovery is driven by timing: large commercial projects in hospitals, schools, railways and government infrastructure that were delayed in FY26 are now converting to orders and revenue. The acquisition of the Aldridge Traffic Systems (ATS) street light business, bought out of administration ~12 months ago, is now contributing profitably after a full year of rebuilding the sales team and customer relationships, including a major win on the Eastern Freeway project in Victoria. The company has pulled $1M of fixed costs out with another $1M to come, giving it margin resilience even in a potential downturn. Gross margins have held up despite supply-side cost pressures. The company has no residential exposure (99% commercial/industrial) and manufactures ~75% of products domestically across Sydney and Brisbane facilities.
quote: Order book has jumped in the last few months above 10 million and the first quarter result that we've just released of sales of 7.25 million is second best quarter of in the company's history and up 64% on on last year. And again, EBITDA +.55 million, we actually made a loss in the in the previous first quarter last year. So momentum's back in their direction, partly just the the the industry that we're operating in, in the commercial lighting side as as bounced back, but also through the acquisition that we did of the Aldridge Street light business a year ago is now starting to pay dividends and results.
episode_title: FOS Capital eyes further growth after strong quarter
